dog.description_text:
🐶 11 weeks old
🐾 Potential Hound/Dachshund Mix
💕 Professional snuggler in training!
Buddy is the adorable pup with white on his face, and his smaller buddy Tiny has the solid-colored face!
Both boys are shy, quiet little sweethearts who are still learning that the world isn't such a scary place. But Buddy has already discovered one of life's greatest pleasures — being held and SNUGGLED! 🥰
Buddy loves spending time outdoors exploring, but he's just as happy relaxing inside with his favorite people.
🐱 Good with cats
👧 Best suited for a family with older children
❤️ Sweet, gentle, and a little shy
🐾 Loves being held and cuddled!
dog.name: Buddy
